failure_condition: The accessible name 'Find' does not contain the visible label 'Search'.
interaction_steps: Compare the visible button label with its accessible name.
expected_outcome: The accessible name contains the complete visible label.
manual_verification_method: Inspect the visible label and computed name in the Accessibility pane.
